name: Severe allergic reaction
warning_signs: Trouble breathing|Swollen lips or tongue|Feeling faint|Hives all over after a trigger
triage_answer: Swelling, hives or trouble breathing after a trigger
medical_kit_items: Epinephrine device in the kit (brand NEEDS VALIDATION)|Pulse oximeter|Blood pressure cuff

name: Solar particle event
warning_signs: Alert from the system or the dosimeter|Nausea or vomiting after exposure

name: Cardiac arrest
warning_signs: Not responding|Not breathing or only gasping

name: Irregular heartbeat with symptoms
warning_signs: Palpitations|Irregular pulse|Dizziness or fainting|Short of breath

name: Chest pain
warning_signs: Pressure or pain spreading to arm or jaw|Sweating|Nausea
triage_answer: Chest pain or very high blood pressure

name: Breathing difficulty
triage_answer: Short of breath or low oxygen

name: Decompression sickness
warning_signs: Deep joint pain after EVA|Tingling or numbness|Vision changes|Confusion
triage_answer: Joint pain or numbness after EVA

name: Dehydration or heat illness
warning_signs: Strong thirst|Dark or little urine|Dizziness|Cramps|High temperature
triage_answer: Fever, very hot or very thirsty

name: Sudden eye problem
warning_signs: New blurred vision|Loss of part of vision|Eye pain|Something in the eye

name: Headache with high CO₂
warning_signs: Headache|Congestion|Tiredness with high cabin or suit CO₂
